description:
This 4.8L Mini PC packs more performance than most full-sized desktops. I took a refurbished Minisforum MS-02 Ultra barebones unit, dropped in an Intel Core Ultra 2 235HX and a used RTX 5060 Low Profile GPU, and turned it into the ultimate small form factor console killer. From the custom living room UI using Winhanced to high-end 1440p gaming benchmarks, here is everything it takes to build and run this machine.
